notes.title: CUSTOMIZATION UPDATE
notes.content:
This is BIG!
Now you can enter CREATION HUB and make a custom performance environment. Watch the video to see how to work with objects, environments, paint tools, lighting and band role placement to make your own scenes. 
Then play in them!
And STREAM your work.

Coming next - Steam Workshop support so you'll be able to customize all sorts of stuff.

notes.title: OK people - lotsa new stuff in this UPDATE
notes.content:
New stuff - let me count the ways:

1 - LEVELS OF DIFFICUTLY  - for Guitar and Drums. Now Easy, Medium and the (old) Hard versions. About three quarters of the Drums LODs are in and a third of the Guitar LODs. The rest should be rolling in over the coming two weeks. Slightly different User Flow on starting a song - Select Artist, Selet the Song (so it is highlighted), then LOD, then Start.

2 - New GUITAR HANDLING - With the guitar locked to you, use the fret hand controller trigger while playing. The avatar hand will stay locked to the guitar neck as you slide it up and down. Center the fret hand finger in the color coded zone for gameplay.

3 - LIVE STREAMING - Built into the game! Input your Livestream Key and then you can turn it OFF and ON from IN-GAME. Can also choose webcam source as overlay in the Main Menu LiveStreaming Config icon. Share your gameplay!

4 - Couple new AVATARs - check out the DJ Zombie and the Squid!

5 - AUDIO FIXES - Hopefully we have sorted all the bugs and crashes from various bitrate speakers and headsets!

Note - for Livestreaming the dekstop display on your PC is set to the In-Game camera display, but that is changeable from a button on the Main Menu in the LiveStreaming Config icon.

notes.title: Another Bug Fix update pushed
notes.content:
We pushed an update to fix issues with Start/Stop of songs, and failed exits to the Main Menu using the Home icon.

Keep letting us know about problems - we are working on fixing all of them!

notes.title: Another Update
notes.content:
We have fixed the bug preventing the drumsticks and microphone from using the volume and drum height sliders.

We have also started putting facial motion capture on the lead singer - look for it in songs like "Sex and Candy" and "Rocky Mountain Way". More coming.

notes.title: UPDATE RELEASED
notes.content:
We have released an update with new features and fixes:

- OCULUS RIFT support. 

- 2 New LIVE tracks. Only in the Megastage. EUROPE, "THE FINAL COUNTDOWN", and POISON, "EVERY ROSE HAS ITS THORN".

- More MOCAP NPCs - now 2 songs, Poison "Nothing but a good time" and Tesla "Modern Day Cowboy" show previews of our upcoming NPC mode.

- More clear messaging if an audio issue conflicts with gameplay. The game may ask you to reset and restart when it detects a conflict.

- Various other bug fixes and optimizations.
